messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: p99 latency SLO breach (service: inference-service-us-west, model: rw-small-8q). Threshold: 1.2s, observed p99: 3.8s, alert_id=PD-98321
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident PD-98321 created and routed to oncall schedule 'eng-oncall/us-west' :loud_sound:
pagerduty: Pager acknowledged by kevin
maria: seeing the alert, pulling up dashboards now. any customer errors reported?
kevin: acked. not seeing 5xx spikes yet, just token generation latency climbing. p95 ~ 1.6s, p99 ~ 3.8s. Region: us-west only.
jamie: adding metric snapshot: `sum(requests) per sec ~ 420, average seq len ~ 128, kv-cache hit rate dropped from 92% -> 34% over last 2m`
maria: kv-cache drop possible hotkey / eviction. can someone check sidecar logs for `KVCacheEvict` churn?
kevin: tailing sidecar logs now 
kevin: found repeated `KVCacheEvict` and `KVCacheWarmupMiss` in sidecar-0..3 for shard-2. timestamps align with p99 spike.
jamie: rolling rolling 1s graphs show a fanout of requests to new nodes -> autoscaler created some new sidecars and they didn't warm cache. autoscaler event: `scale up 3 -> 6` 2m ago.
maria: sounds like cold-warm penalty + batching increase = long tails. runbook step 2: consider traffic isolation by routing small requests to fallback model variant or pin to warm pool.
kevin: can we pin the heavy customers off this pool? we have route policy 'region-fanout' that can set `prefer_warm=true` or fallback model `rw-small-8q-fast`
jamie: config snippet: ```yaml
routing:
  region: us-west
  prefer_warm: true
  fallback_model: rw-small-8q-fast
```
kevin: executing temporary reroute: `infra route set --policy region-fanout --prefer-warm=true --dry-run=false` (will apply to 15% of traffic initially)
incident-bot: Change executed by kevin: region-fanout prefer_warm=true (15% rollout)
maria: good. also increasing dedicated pool warm replicas: `infra scale dedicated-pool us-west-warm --replicas 8` will add warm workers only (no model reload). kicking now.
kevin: scaling in progress. infra reports new warm instances provisioning (2/4 -> 8 target).
jamie: monitoring p99 after reroute + warm scaling... p99 dropped from 3.8s -> 2.1s within 60s for the routed traffic slice. overall p99 still 2.8s.
sre-lead: if p99 doesn't go < 1.2s in 10m we should consider temporary canary rollback of recent autoscaler changes or enable request-level KV pre-warm for active keys.
maria: agree. I'll open a pre-warm job to prime top keys: `tools/kv_warm --region us-west --top-n 1000 &`
kevin: pre-warm job started. also reducing max-batch-size on hot path to 8 to reduce queuing: `config apply inference.max_batch_size=8 --scope us-west-hot`
jamie: note: reducing batch size increases cost but should reduce tail latency. observing immediate reduction in per-request latency in hot slice.
kevin: PagerDuty note: PD-98321 acknowledged -> marked as 'investigating'. tagging customer-impact: potential increased latency for a subset of enterprise customers in us-west, no 5xx at this time.
maria: contacting CSMs to flag high-latency ticket for customers with SLA requirements. posting to #customer-impact.
jenkins-bot: deploy job `infra-scale-hot-warm` succeeded (duration 45s).
kevin: warm replicas at target. p99 across region now 1.4s; p95 0.9s. still above SLO by small margin but trending down.
jamie: KV hit-rate for shard-2 back up to 88% after warmers came up and pre-warm completed.
sre-lead: great. start staged de-escalation: reduce PagerDuty urgency, keep the incident open for 30m post-stability. mark next steps in incident tracker.
kevin: lowering pager priority to P2 (no longer noisy). updating PD with note: Mitigations: reroute prefer_warm (15%), increased warm pool replicas, pre-warm top keys, reduced max batch size.
incident-bot: PD-98321 status changed: acknowledged -> monitoring.
maria: preparing handoff notes for alex-next-oncall (night shift). alex, I'll DM you full context but main things: cause appears to be autoscaler-induced cold warm penalty and consequent KV warm misses. mitigations applied: routing fallback, warm pool scale, pre-warm, batch size reduction. watchlist: shard-2 warm churn, autoscaler policy.
alex-next-oncall: thanks, will take 30m watch and keep PD on watch. any followups needed from infra team?
jamie: followups: adjust autoscaler cooldown from 30s -> 120s for warm-only pools; add pre-warm hook in scale-up path; add alert for KVCacheEvict rate > 5/min. filing infra ticket INFRA-4721.
kevin: adding runbook note about `prefer_warm` rollout template.
sre-lead: good job team. leave incident open for 30m after last anomalous event or until alex confirms. if p99 resurges to >2.0s re-open escalation.
alex-next-oncall: acknowledged. taking watch. :thumbsup:
kevin: closing slack thread for live coordination, will update incident tracker with timeline.
